verdict.rationale: React's own docs explicitly recommend Next.js and React Router as full-stack frameworks for routing and data fetching (react-docs-4, react-docs-21), and describe server component data-fetching patterns (react-docs-7). However, these are third-party frameworks not maintained by the React team itself, so it's an endorsement rather than an official first-party meta-framework. Missing for 10: evidence of a React-team-maintained meta-framework, and independent corroboration of how well the recommended frameworks integrate with core React APIs.
